whenToUse: A quote builder laid out like the final proposal with catalogue line items and KDV.
Deal desks that check discount bands and margin, route approval and send for e-signature.
avoidWhen: A finished order with payments — use detail-05.
A signed agreement with clauses and renewals — use detail-11.
a11y: The discount indicator is role="meter" with aria-valuetext; totals update in an aria-live region.
Sections are named regions (aria-labelledby) so users can jump between document and desk.
